gloss: moving in; transfer (to a new school, area, etc.)

definitions.gloss: moving in; registering as a new resident
definitions.explanation: The act of officially moving into a new municipality or area and registering at the local ward or city office.

definitions.gloss: transfer; transferring in (to a new school or workplace)
definitions.explanation: Entering a new school or organization as a transfer, not from the beginning.

examples.japanese: {転入届|てんにゅうとどけ}を{出|だ}す。
{引|ひ}っ{越|こ}したら{14日以内|じゅうよっかいない}に{転入届|てんにゅうとどけ}を{提出|ていしゅつ}してください。
examples.english: Please submit the move-in registration within 14 days of moving.

examples.japanese: {市役所|しやくしょ}で{転入|てんにゅう}の{手続|てつづ}きをした。
examples.english: I completed the move-in procedures at the city hall.

examples.japanese: {転入生|てんにゅうせい}を{紹介|しょうかい}する。
{二学期|にがっき}から{転入|てんにゅう}してきた。
examples.english: I transferred in starting from the second semester.

examples.japanese: {転入|てんにゅう}{試験|しけん}に{合格|ごうかく}して{新|あたら}しい{学校|がっこう}に{通|かよ}い{始|はじ}めた。
examples.english: I passed the transfer exam and started attending the new school.

notes:
A key administrative and school term. When moving between municipalities in Japan, residents must submit a {転出届|てんしゅつとどけ} (move-out notice) at their old address and a {転入届|てんにゅうとどけ} (move-in notice) at the new one.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {転入届|てんにゅうとどけ}: move-in registration form
- {転入|てんにゅう}{手続|てつづ}き: move-in procedures
- {転入生|てんにゅうせい}: transfer student
- {転入|てんにゅう}{試験|しけん}: transfer entrance exam
- {転入|てんにゅう}する: to move in; to transfer

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {転出|てんしゅつ}: moving out — the opposite, leaving a municipality or school
- {引|ひ}っ{越|こ}し: moving (house) — the general act of relocating, without the administrative nuance
- {転校|てんこう}: school transfer — specifically changing schools, subset of sense 2
- {入居|にゅうきょ}: moving in (to a dwelling) — focuses on entering a specific residence, not municipal registration
